The big issue with most antennas is that they're omnidirectional and that loses you a lot of gain. Switch that to a focused antenna, particularly when in an array and you see massive improvements in range.

That said, you don't really want a unidirectional transmitter, because it makes it too hard to aim the two of them. You want something that you can set up and go, not have to calibrate both ends carefully for half an hour and then hope nobody bumps it. But it's easy enough to build what is basically a wifi bridge that encodes, Plug it in inside range of your open network, walk away and then carefully aim your antenna array once you're back at home.

You must like a challenge! I never tried Dead Space 3. What do you like most about it?

Dead Space 3 was one of the best Coops ever in my mind. The enemies are challenging to take down, so teamwork and watching each others back became an important part of the play-through. The second player was also integrated into the story nicely. Playing the support role as Carver was fun and you felt important as you helped Issac through the story. I found that even playing with randoms you would both naturally fall into your roles. Issac doing all the puzzles and button pushing. Carver securing the room and watching Issac's back. The weapon crafting system was deep and there was plenty of tense moments and crazy battles. Overall a great story and interesting gameplay change ups. Made it one of my favs.
